title: National Academies
description: Workshops and public discussions in science, engineering, health, and AI. Some committee sessions are closed; check attendance details.

title: Johns Hopkins University
description: University talks, workshops, and conferences, including AI, public policy, and health. Audience and registration restrictions vary.

title: House Science Committee
description: Official hearings and recordings on research and technology. Check the AI issue filter and confirm schedules and visitor requirements.

title: Senate Commerce Committee
description: Official hearings on technology, communications, consumer protection, and science. Recent AI hearing recordings are also available.

title: NIST
description: Standards, measurement, evaluation, privacy, and security events. The automatic feed selects AI-related notices; many agency events are unrelated to AI.

title: National Science Foundation
description: Research and funding webinars, office hours, and public meetings. Automatic notices come from the official NSF events RSS feed.

title: Smithsonian Institution
description: Museum talks and public programs on science, technology, history, and culture. Search for AI and confirm whether a program is in person or online.

title: National Museum of American History
description: Public programs with a history-of-technology lens. This is a general museum calendar, not a dedicated AI feed.

title: Eventbrite · Washington, DC
description: Community meetups, training, and commercial conferences. Organizer-submitted listings need independent checks of venue, fees, and claims.

title: Eventbrite · Maryland
description: Search Baltimore-area AI events, then refine the location for nearby Maryland communities. Listings are not vetted endorsements.

title: Eventbrite · Northern Virginia
description: Search Arlington-area AI events and expand to nearby Northern Virginia. Verify the organizer and delivery format before registering.
